events.evidence: The Walt Disney Company reports it is entering a billion unsecured credit agreement, possibly to make up for shortfalls in its theme park division.
The United States Navy confirms the first death of a sailor serving aboard the aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt. Over 500 sailors on the ship have tested positive for the virus.
GNA forces recapture the city of Sabratha, and the nearby town of Sorman in the Zawiya District
